note: Grid puzzles for Bip's Path, Fix-It and Repeat Robot. Every level was generated from a fixed seed and checked solvable by breadth-first search; optimalProgram is a shortest solution. Rows count from the top (row 0). Bip starts facing up. 'turns' levels use forward/turnLeft/turnRight like a floor robot. Fix-It levels give a buggyProgram with one wrong block (bugIndex) to find and replace with 'fix'.
